messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 — az1a egress UDP fragmentation spike (>12% sustained, 5m). High truncated DNS responses (TC bit), resolver retries rising, grpc streams observing RST/502. Affects hosted inference in az1a. Dashboard: https://metrics.redwood/az1a/egress-frag — paging oncall.
oncall-alice: acked. I'm jumping on it. @net-ben you up? tagging infra for visibility.
net-ben: on it, looking at resolver logs and MTU counters on the az1a egress fleet.
infra-carlos: seeing increased ip_fragments on host NICs, some instances show MTU negotiation errors after recent kernel upgrade.
oncall-alice: assign runbook: https://runbook.internal/egress/udp-frag and start mitigation steps. I'll coordinate traffic shift if needed.
sre-dana: customers reporting elevated 5xx and stream resets. CS says a few large customers saw request latency + failures. @psm-jordan please collate customer list.
psm-jordan: compiling list now, hitting 4 customers with >5% error uplift in last 10m. Preparing templated customer note.
net-ben: quick check — DNS responses >512 bytes with EDNS present are being fragmented. Probe shows path MTU to resolver endpoint fluctuating between 1200-1500 bytes.
oncall-alice: mitigation idea: temporarily disable EDNS on our resolver forwarders to keep responses <512 and avoid fragmentation. Any objections?
infra-carlos: can do on the az1a forwarders via ansible. Will push a targeted change to the az1a autoscaling group only. Rolling out to all regions would be heavier.
deploy-bot: CI job queued: ansible-playbook site.yml -l az1a-resolvers --tags disable_edns
oncall-alice: net-ben, please confirm graceful change steps and expected rollback.
net-ben: plan: (1) flip disable_edns flag on az1a forwarders, (2) restart resolver service, (3) monitor truncation rate and grpc 5xx. Rollback: re-enable EDNS if unexpected side-effects. Estimated 6 min for rollout.
oncall-alice: do it. Keep changes scoped to resolver ASG; no global DNS changes.
infra-carlos: running playbook now. snippet:
```
PLAY [az1a-resolvers]
TASK [set_fact] *******************************************
ok: [resolver-az1a-01]
ok: [resolver-az1a-02]
TASK [restart resolver]
changed: [resolver-az1a-01]
changed: [resolver-az1a-02]
```
net-ben: monitoring: truncation rate down from 18% -> 3% within 90s. IP fragment counter falling.
sre-dana: application metrics: grpc RSTs p95 dropping, 5xx count trending back toward baseline. Good sign.
oncall-alice: traffic steering: initiating temporary regional spill to eu1b for new inference sessions that allow cross-region routing. Activating policy: prefer eu1b for non-low-latency sessions.
oncall-alice: command run: routingctl set-preference --from az1a --to eu1b --pct 25 --selector non-low-latency
deploy-bot: routing change applied. monitor for error amplification.
psm-jordan: customer note drafted and ready, will send to affected customers once we confirm stabilization.
net-ben: keeping watch on kernel NIC error logs — I see a subset of hosts with offload drop counters incrementing. Scheduling a host drain for the worst 3 nodes.
infra-carlos: draining 3 hosts: kube drain --ignore-daemonsets node/az1a-host-45 && cordon node/az1a-host-45
oncall-alice: thanks. SRE, please track rollback steps if any of these make perf worse.
sre-dana: confirmed no adverse effect from the resolver EDNS toggle. We'll keep it for 24h while we validate.
psm-jordan: sent customer notifications with ETA and mitigation summary. No escalations so far.
oncall-alice: summary: root cause likely path MTU oscillation after recent NIC/kernel changes + EDNS-enabled DNS responses causing fragmentation -> resolver truncation -> higher retries and grpc chattiness -> inference 5xx spike. Short-term mitigations: disable EDNS on az1a forwarders, drain impacted hosts, traffic spill to eu1b. Next: patch kernel on affected hosts and validate MTU negotiation.
net-ben: opening infra ticket to revert recent kernel/net-driver change and plan controlled re-roll: INT-4789.
sre-dana: logging post-incident check: collect pcap on one host, CPU/IO stats, DNS query sizes for 24h window.
oncall-alice: leaving notification to oncall rotation: handoff to next oncall in 2h. @sre-dana will own postmortem draft.
psm-jordan: will follow up with customers with final timeline in 3h.
incident-bot: ALERT cleared: truncation rate below threshold for 10m, 5xx restored to baseline. Incident state: mitigated. Please file postmortem and tag INT-4789.
